name: Mobile phones and accessories

problems.words: IMEI ka in aur out ka record nahi
quick_ideas: Note the IMEI of every handset in stock once, so you know exactly what you hold
Write the IMEI on every bill from today, so returns and warranty claims have proof.

workzap_build.text: an IMEI-level stock register with purchase type, cost, condition, sale date and warranty end.

problems.ask_first: Do you buy used phones from walk-ins?
problems.free_stops: How IMEIs are captured and searched is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare handsets physically on shelves with the in and out notebook once, so missing or extra pieces are spotted early.
Make one staff member update one handset movement notebook at handover time, so every sale and receipt lands in one place.

problems.words: Used phone kharidte hain, baad mein pata chalta hai blocked hai
quick_ideas: Write down the checks you do before buying, so every staff member does the same
Agree that a phone failing any check is not bought, so no one makes an exception under pressure.

workzap_build.text: a used-phone intake checklist with tests, photos, IMEI and an approval step before purchase.

problems.free_stops: The checklist and approval step are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note how many used phones bought this week later show blocking or dispute issues, so the real loss pattern becomes visible.
Give one person the final buy or reject call for used phones, so rushed purchases stop slipping through mixed staff judgment.

problems.words: Repair wala phone dhoondna parta hai, galat phone wapas de diya
quick_ideas: Give every repair a numbered slip and a matching tag on the phone, so each phone has an ID
Keep repairs in labelled trays by status, so finding a phone takes seconds.

workzap_build.text: a repair job board with job number, fault, technician, parts and status, and a WhatsApp ready message.

problems.free_stops: The job flow and messages are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many repair phones were searched for or nearly returned wrong this week, so you see where mixups are hitting hardest.
Assign one shelf area only for ready to return repairs with slips attached, so handover mistakes drop at the counter.

problems.words: Technician kehta hai part badla, verify nahi kar sakte
quick_ideas: Keep the old part with the job slip, so a replacement can be checked
Write down parts issued for each job, so stock and jobs can be matched.

workzap_build.text: a parts register linking each part to a job and supplier, with comebacks tracked.

problems.ask_first: Who issues parts to the technician?
problems.free_stops: How parts are linked and comebacks tracked is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare parts taken from stock with repair slips once this week, so jobs and used parts can be matched clearly.
Make one person receive removed parts back with each completed repair, so replacement claims stop resting on verbal updates.

problems.words: Accessories ke sau items, kuch pata nahi kya para hai
quick_ideas: Count your top accessories once, so you know what's really there
Give the fast movers a code or barcode, so sales of small items get recorded.

workzap_build.text: accessory stock with barcodes, low-stock alerts and a counter-wise daily count.

problems.free_stops: How items are coded and counted is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Walk the accessories wall once and note empty hooks beside overfilled spots, so slow and fast lines are obvious together.
Give one person one notebook page for accessories added and taken from display daily, so stock movement stops getting lost.

quick_ideas: Write each payment method's total separately at closing, so one doesn't hide another
Use one shop wallet account, so no payment lands on a personal number.

workzap_build.text: daily reconciliation across cash, cards and wallets.

problems.free_stops: How each method is matched is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many customers ask to pay one way and switch at the counter this week, so the busiest mismatch is clear.
Keep one notebook at the counter for failed payment attempts and assign one person to mark each case, so repeat confusion gets noticed fast.

problems.words: Salesman ek hi phone ke alag rate batate hain
quick_ideas: Share one price list with all salesmen each morning, so everyone quotes the same
Note quotes given for a week, so you see how wide the spread is.

workzap_build.text: a daily price list sent to all salesmen and shops.

problems.ask_first: How often do your prices change?
problems.free_stops: How prices are updated and shared is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Ask each salesman separately for the same phone details once this week, so differences in model understanding show before customers hear mixed answers.
Give one person the job of writing each phone's exact storage, color and condition on one counter page daily, so salesmen describe the same item.

problems.words: OLX/Dubizzle pe messages ka jawab nahi de paate
quick_ideas: Count unanswered messages once, so you know how many buyers are waiting
Give one person the listings, so replies don't depend on who is free.

workzap_build.text: listing enquiries collected in one place with follow-up reminders and stock status.

problems.free_stops: How messages are collected and followed up is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count listing messages left unanswered by closing time once, so you know how much buyer interest is being missed.
Give one staff member one fixed reply window for listings each day, so messages stop waiting until someone gets free.

problems.words: Trade-in ke baad profit ka pata nahi
quick_ideas: Work out profit on your last few trade-in sales once, so you see whether trade-ins pay
Include the accessories you bundled, because they are part of the real cost.

workzap_build.text: profit per handset including trade-in value and bundled accessories.

problems.ask_first: How often do you take trade-ins?
problems.free_stops: How profit per phone is calculated is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Look at recent trade in slips and note missing details like condition, box or repair notes, so weak records around each deal stand out.
Make one person add a handwritten condition note to every trade in slip before display, so later sale discussions start from the same record.

never_say: How to bypass PTA, change IMEIs, unlock JV or remove iCloud.
How to buy or resell stolen phones.
To ask for customers' passcodes or account details.
Anything on customs, tax or telecom rules; robbery or battery fire goes to emergency services first.
That counterfeit accessories can be sold as original.

sample_reply.person: Repair ke kaam mein gadbad hai, customer aata hai to phone dhoondna parta hai. Solution batao.
sample_reply.pi: Ji haan, iska aasaan shuru hai aur aaj se ho sakta hai. 1) Har repair ko number wali slip aur phone pe wahi number ka tag dein, taa ke har phone ki pehchaan ho. 2) Repair wale phones label wali trays mein rakhein, taa ke dhoondna na pare. Workzap ye aap ke liye khud-ba-khud kar sakta hai: repair board jis mein har job ka number, technician, part aur status ho, aur phone ready hone pe customer ko WhatsApp message. Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
